metadata.title: Local structure of sumsets and projections of self-affine carpets
metadata.abstract: We show that if $X$ and $Y$ are self-similar sets in $\mathbb{R}$ with multiplicatively independent contraction ratios, then the Assouad dimension of $X+Y$ is one. As an application, we show that for a large class of self-affine carpets, the Assouad dimension of any non-principal orthogonal projection is one. The latter result is new even for the simplest case of Bedford-McMullen carpets.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 证明收缩比乘法独立的实直线自相似集之和具有 Assouad 维数一，并推出一大类自仿射地毯的非主方向正交投影 Assouad 维数一。
analysis.breakthrough: 即便 Bedford–McMullen 地毯也得到新的局部维数结论。
analysis.limitations: Assouad 维数一不意味着正 Lebesgue 测度，也不直接确定 Hausdorff 维数。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT-6-Astra 将手绘图转成图2的 TikZ 代码，并明确其他准备与问题求解未使用 AI。
